//: LilyGo T-Deck: ESP32-S3FN16R8 — 16 MB quad flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM — with
an SX1262, a 320x240 ST7789, a keyboard and a trackball. platform-espressif32
has no board for it, so this is the ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 definition with the
T-Deck's memory: 16 MB flash and OPI PSRAM (memory_type qio_opi). Getting
the PSRAM type wrong is not a soft failure: the board boot-loops.
USB: the T-Deck has no USB-serial bridge. The S3's own USB is the only port,
so Serial must be the native CDC (cdc_on_boot = 1) or the debug trace goes
nowhere. USB mode 1 (hardware CDC/JTAG) is also what lets esptool reset it
into the bootloader without anybody holding the trackball.
name: LilyGo T-Deck
